2609.08606.title: Neptune: An AI model for Global Ocean Subseasonal Prediction
2609.08606.paper_summary: Subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) forecasting is societally critical, supporting decision-making in sectors ranging from water and agricultural management to disaster risk reduction, energy planning, and insurance. Achieving reliable predictions at these timescales requires representing the ocean and its dynamics, but traditional physics-based Ocean General Circulation Models (OGCMs), are computationally expensive and difficult to develop and improve because of the code complexity. In this work, we propose Neptune, an end-to-end data-driven framework for global ocean and sea-ice components emulation tailored for S2S timescales, up to 60 days. Neptune combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Spherical Fourier Neural Operators (SFNOs) to effectively capture local features and global cross-scale interactions, thereby obtaining a coherent representation of the ocean state. Forced by prescribed daily atmospheric fields, Neptune emulates ocean state variables, from temperature and salinity, to zonal and meridional currents, from sea surface height to sea ice thickness and concentration, with daily outputs at the ocean surface and through the water column. Specifically, we propose two variants of Neptune, Neptune-1 and Neptune-025, capable of emulating the ocean state at 1° and 0.25° resolution, respectively. Evaluated against a suite of metrics, including statistics (RMSE, CRPS and ACC), physical coherency (Ocean Heat Content, Eddy Kinetic Energy and Ice Brier Score) and climate indices (ENSO and Z20 metric, IOD), Neptune successfully reproduces the spatio-temporal evolution of the oceanic fields up to 60 days, and is stable over long timescales. Neptune provides compelling evidence that end-to-end data-driven ocean emulators can become a powerful component of next-generation S2S forecasting systems, emulating ocean state at high spatio-temporal resolution.
2609.08606.paper_summary_zh: 次季節性到季節性（S2S）預測對社會至關重要，支持從水資源和農業管理到災害風險減少、能源規劃和保險等各個領域的決策。要在這些時間尺度上實現可靠的預測，需要對海洋及其動力學進行表徵，但傳統的基於物理的海洋大氣環流模型（OGCMs）計算成本高，且由於代碼複雜性，開發和改進困難。在這項工作中，我們提出了Neptune，一個端到端的數據驅動框架，用於全球海洋和海冰組件的模擬，專為S2S時間尺度（最多60天）量身定制。Neptune結合了卷積神經網絡（CNNs）和球面傅里葉神經運算符（SFNOs），有效捕捉局部特徵和全球跨尺度交互，從而獲得海洋狀態的連貫表徵。在指定的每日大氣場驅動下，Neptune模擬海洋狀態變量，從溫度和鹽度，到經向和緯向洋流，從海面高度到海冰厚度和濃度，並在海洋表面和水柱中提供每日輸出。具體而言，我們提出了兩個Neptune的變體，分別是Neptune-1和Neptune-025，能夠以1°和0.25°的解析度模擬海洋狀態。根據一系列指標進行評估，包括統計（RMSE、CRPS和ACC）、物理一致性（海洋熱含量、渦動能和冰布里爾分數）以及氣候指數（ENSO和Z20指標、IOD），Neptune成功再現了海洋場的時空演變，長達60天，並在長時間尺度上保持穩定。Neptune提供了令人信服的證據，表明端到端的數據驅動海洋模擬器可以成為下一代S2S預測系統的強大組成部分，以高時空解析度模擬海洋狀態。
